summary_en: TOAMI Corporation will acquire up to 30,000 shares (0.5% of shares outstanding excluding treasury stock) on November 19, 2026 via ToSTNeT-3 at the November 18 closing price of 614 yen per share, for a maximum total of 18,420,000 yen.
title_en: Notice on acquisition of treasury shares and purchase of treasury shares through off-auction trading transaction (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On November 18, 2026, TOAMI Corporation's board of directors authorized an execution of treasury share acquisition via off-auction trading (ToSTNeT-3). The company will purchase up to 30,000 shares at the closing price of 614 yen per share on November 18, 2026, during the first trading session of ToSTNeT-3 on November 19, 2026 at 8:45 a.m. The maximum total acquisition amount is 18,420,000 yen. This represents 0.5% of shares outstanding (5,643,916 shares) as of the announcement date, excluding treasury stock. The company stated the purpose is to implement flexible capital policy in response to changing business environments. Actual execution may be partial or not occur depending on market conditions. Results will be announced after the trading session ends on November 19.
